name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 31 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-05-15, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
